PC08-004.name: Floor of the Starry Sky
PC08-004.effect:
[Type: Song]

[Flash]
You can return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. Also, if you control any "Oozora Akari", you can return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom. If you control any "Hoshimiya Ichigo", these effects can't be prevented by opposing effects.

PC08-005.name: MY STARWAY
PC08-005.effect:
[Type: Song]

[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
[During Set] (Your Main Step)
When you're summoning "Hoshimiya Ichigo"/"Kiriya Aoi"/"Shibuki Ran", fulfill one of its reduction symbols.

[Flash]
Refresh an "Idol" family Spirit you control. Then, you can immediately end the battle.

PC08-003.name: ［Magical Emerald Coord］Kamiya Shion
PC08-003.effect:
[team: Powapowa-Puririn]

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Put a core from the Void to your Life/any of your "Idol" family Spirit, and return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Kiriya Aoi" or [Powapowa-Puririn] Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.

PC08-001.name: ［Magical Garden Coord］Kitaouji Sakura
PC08-001.effect:
[teams: Powapowa-Puririn STAR ANIS]

Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
By sending your [Soul Core] from your Trash to any of your "Idol" & "Stage Style" family Spirit, summon this card from the Hand without paying the cost. When you've done so, when this battle ends, end the Attack Step.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
All your [Powapowa-Puririn] or [Tristar] Spirits are unaffected by opposing Spirit effects.

PC08-002.name: ［Magical Yellow Coord］Arisugawa Otome
PC08-002.effect:
[teams: Powapowa-Puririn STAR ANIS]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Put two cores from the Void to any of your "Idol" family Spirits.

[LV2][LV3]
When your "Idol" family Spirits would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can summon an "Idol" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

PC08-X03.name: ［Sunset Starway Coord］Shibuki Ran
PC08-X03.effect:
[teams: Soleil STAR ANIS]

Flash - (Your Turn)
You can switch this card from the Hand with a "［Sunset Coord］Shibuki Ran" you control in the same condition. When you've done so, during this turn, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your [Soleil] Spirit is switched into the Field/attacks, during this turn, give an opposing Spirit -10000 BP, and destroy it when its BP is brought to 0.

PC08-X02.name: ［Sunshine Starway Coord］Hoshimiya Ichigo
PC08-X02.effect:
[teams: Soleil STAR ANIS]

Flash - (Your Turn)
You can switch this card from the Hand with a "［Sunshine Coord］Hoshimiya Ichigo" you control in the same condition. When you've done so, return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
Your [Soleil] Spirits can't be destroyed by opposing effects, and once per turn per Spirit, can refresh at the end of battle.

PC08-X01.name: ［Sunrise Starway Coord］Kiriya Aoi
PC08-X01.effect:
[teams: Soleil STAR ANIS]

Flash - (Your Turn)
You can switch this card from the Hand with a "［Sunrise Coord］Kiriya Aoi" you control in the same condition. When you've done so, draw two cards.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your [Soleil] Spirits gain an extra Yellow symbol, and can't be blocked.
